import awkward as ak
from pocket_coffea.lib.cut_definition import Cut
from pocket_coffea.lib.categorization import Cartesian, MultiCut

# Jet multiplicity binning: exactly 4, exactly 5, at least 6 jets
njets_binning = MultiCut(
    "njets",
    [
        Cut("eq4", lambda ev: ak.num(ev.JetGood) == 4),
        Cut("eq5", lambda ev: ak.num(ev.JetGood) == 5),
        Cut("ge6", lambda ev: ak.num(ev.JetGood) >= 6),
    ]
)

# B-tag multiplicity binning: exactly 2, at least 3 b-tags
nbtags_binning = MultiCut(
    "nbtags",
    [
        Cut("eq2", lambda ev: ak.num(ev.JetGood[ev.JetGood.btagDeepB > 0.5]) == 2),
        Cut("ge3", lambda ev: ak.num(ev.JetGood[ev.JetGood.btagDeepB > 0.5]) >= 3),
    ]
)

# Cartesian product automatically creates all 6 category combinations
categories = Cartesian([njets_binning, nbtags_binning])
